text:
Under the approach whereby all fuel economy measures, and their impacts, are attributable to the AFES, the annual savings of gasoline over MY 1976 levels for the MY 1979 nonpassenger automobile fleet, except for recreational-type NPA's with off-road capability, manufactured by domestic manufacturers (including NPA's produced domestically, and "captive imports," i.e., foreign manufactured vehicles imported and sold by domestic manufacturers) would be between 68.9 million gallons and 100.7 million gallons. This assumes a fleet size of 1.06 million vehicles traveling 11,000 miles per year. Assuming a ten year lifetime of the fleet, the AFES would result in a lifetime savings of between 689 million gallons and 1007 million gallons.
For the class of recreational-type NPA's with off-road capability, the annual savings of gasoline would be between 0.16 million gallons and 2.04 million gallons. This assumes a fleet size of 40,000 new vehicles traveling 11,000 miles per year, assuming a ten-year lifetime of the fleet, the AFES would result in a lifetime savings of between 1.6 million gallons and 20.4 million gallons.
